sources.title: Microsoft Research Publishes AI Weather Forecasting Study in ...
sources.snippet: Probabilistic bias correction corrects a model's historical probability forecasts rather than relearning atmospheric dynamics. MicroDuet led ECMWF's AI Weather Quest ahead of operational forecasting centers and dozens of competing teams worldwide. The open-source framework targets predictable errors and offers low-overhead gains for resource-constrained meteorological centers.

sources.title: Weather Lab | WeatherNext | Google for Developers
sources.snippet: Weather Lab is an interactive website developed by Google DeepMind and Google Research for exploring AI weather forecasts. It provides a map-based interface for visualizing global forecast layers, tracking tropical cyclones with predicted and observed tracks, and downloading experimental cyclone forecast data.
